title: Reliable multi-RCB reporting, SOE and control audit
titleId: Reporting multi-RCB yang andal, SOE dan audit kontrol
summary: ARSAS 1.6.47 restores the P9 reporting engine, improves Play/Stop reconnect handling and adds evidence-based control outcomes to Event Logs. The SG7_BCU workstation test observed 77/77 Report-backed values and 4/4 independently routed BRCBs.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.47 memulihkan engine reporting P9, memperbaiki penanganan Play/Stop dan reconnect, serta menambahkan hasil kontrol berbasis bukti ke Event Logs. Pengujian SG7_BCU pada workstation mencatat 77/77 nilai dari Report dan 4/4 BRCB dengan trafik terverifikasi secara independen.
highlights: P9 multi-RCB reporting: 77/77 Report-backed values, zero pending and 4/4 independently routed BRCBs in the SG7_BCU workstation test.
Reliable Play/Stop handoff prevents duplicate Start during connection and monitoring activation.
Bounded SOE deduplication removes repeated exact wire data-change identities across overlapping RCBs while retaining distinct historical events.
Unified Event Logs record confirmed, accepted, rejected, not sent and unverified control outcomes; command Quality is blank.
Verified Windows installer and portable EXE with published SHA-256, SPDX SBOM and provenance.
highlightsId: Reporting multi-RCB P9: 77/77 nilai dari Report, tanpa nilai pending, dan 4/4 BRCB dengan trafik terverifikasi secara independen dalam pengujian SG7_BCU pada workstation.
Koordinasi Play/Stop mencegah Start ganda saat koneksi dan aktivasi monitoring.
Deduplikasi SOE berbatas menghapus pengulangan identitas data-change yang sama persis pada RCB yang tumpang tindih, tanpa menghapus event historis yang berbeda.
Event Logs terpadu mencatat hasil kontrol terkonfirmasi, diterima, ditolak, tidak dikirim, dan belum terverifikasi; kolom Quality command kosong.
Installer Windows dan portable EXE terverifikasi dengan SHA-256, SPDX SBOM dan provenance yang dipublikasikan.
improvements: Static DataSet reporting uses actual incoming Reports as process-value authority without cyclic MMS process polling in the tested path.
Control audit distinguishes MMS service acceptance, CommandTermination and independently confirmed process feedback; Check/Test flags are requested parameters.
Event details and CSV retain process quality, timestamps and RCB forensic evidence separately from command audit.
Historical R10 evidence is preserved; the P9 engine is pinned to the exact approved revision rather than an arbitrary newer engine.
improvementsId: Reporting DataSet statis memakai Report yang benar-benar diterima sebagai sumber nilai proses, tanpa polling MMS siklik pada jalur yang diuji.
Audit kontrol membedakan penerimaan layanan MMS, CommandTermination dan feedback proses yang terkonfirmasi secara independen; flag Check/Test adalah parameter yang diminta.
Detail event dan CSV mempertahankan quality, timestamp dan bukti diagnostik RCB secara terpisah dari audit command.
Bukti historis R10 dipertahankan; engine P9 dipin ke revisi yang disetujui, bukan sembarang engine terbaru.
knownLimitations: The SG7_BCU workstation test recorded 128 Report frames, four BufOvfl indications and seven SqNum discontinuities. These are not verified lost-event counts; lossless buffered SOE is not established.
Six-byte MMS BinaryTime has no clock-synchronization quality byte; historical report classification does not certify IED clock quality.
External hardware versus local simulation was not independently established in this workstation test. Full SCL/IID parity and universal vendor compatibility are not certified.
Manual PurgeBuf destroys retained IED history. Use it only on an authorized, idle test BRCB; ARSAS never runs it automatically.
Windows x64 packages are not Authenticode-signed; verify SHA-256. Raw GOOSE/SV requires approved Npcap and control operations require an authorized procedure.
knownLimitationsId: Pengujian SG7_BCU pada workstation mencatat 128 frame Report, empat indikasi BufOvfl dan tujuh diskontinuitas SqNum. Ini bukan jumlah event yang terbukti hilang; SOE buffer tanpa kehilangan belum terverifikasi.
MMS BinaryTime enam byte tidak memiliki byte kualitas sinkronisasi clock; klasifikasi report historis bukan sertifikasi kualitas jam IED.
Perangkat eksternal versus simulasi lokal belum diverifikasi secara independen dalam pengujian workstation ini. Paritas SCL/IID penuh dan kompatibilitas semua vendor tidak tersertifikasi.
PurgeBuf manual menghapus riwayat IED yang tersimpan. Gunakan hanya pada BRCB uji yang idle dan berizin; ARSAS tidak menjalankannya secara otomatis.
Paket Windows x64 belum ditandatangani Authenticode; verifikasi SHA-256. GOOSE/SV membutuhkan Npcap yang disetujui dan operasi kontrol memerlukan prosedur berizin.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable binaries do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
